name: Durable ACK Binding and Work Lifecycle
description: Close the authority gap between Valkey stream ACKs and PGlite durable state. Implement the rule: every terminal Valkey XACK must be preceded by a committed PGlite lifecycle write. Replace simulated durable writes with real Drizzle/PGlite lifecycle writes in completeAndAck, failTerminalAndAck, failRetryableAndAck, and deadLetterAndAck. Implement pending reconciliation that inspects PGlite WorkItemTable before acking. Ensure every test queries both PGlite tables and Valkey stream state for lifecycle assertions.
